subject: POC kickoff: stakeholder map, hands-on lab timing, and success criteria
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@datafoundry.com>, Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff: stakeholder map, hands-on lab timing, and success criteria

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. To get the POC moving quickly, I'd like to lock in two sessions the week of Dec 7: a 45–60 minute kickoff to align stakeholders and success criteria, followed by a 2.5 hour hands-on lab for prompt review, routing validation, and a short load test.

Proposed kickoff slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 (PST)
- Wed Dec 9, 08:30–09:15 (PST)
- Thu Dec 10, 14:00–14:45 (PST)

Hands-on lab (choose one):
- Thu Dec 10, 15:00–17:30 (PST)
- Fri Dec 11, 09:00–11:30 (PST)

Pre-read & attached: POC-runbook-v1.pdf (agenda + roles), sample-prompt-set.csv (initial prompt bank we suggest using for routing and quality checks).

Please confirm:
1) Which kickoff slot works for your team?
2) Who will be the technical lead for load tests and who owns prompt sign-off?
3) Any data residency / VPC constraints to flag before the hands-on?

Draft success criteria (please edit):
- Latency p50 < 120ms for standard prompts on sample workload
- Routing accuracy >= 92% for intent split in the prompt set
- No PII surfaced in logs; audit log visibility for all requests

Once we have a kickoff time confirmed I'll send calendar invites and a short runbook for the hands-on lab.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attachments: POC-runbook-v1.pdf (18 pages), sample-prompt-set.csv (120 rows)
From: Elena Morales <elena@datafoundry.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 18:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: stakeholder map, hands-on lab timing, and success criteria

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear plan and materials. We're keen to proceed but two quick notes:
1) We have an executive all-hands on Tue afternoon (ET), so the Tue 10:00 PST slot will conflict for our Product VP.
2) Can you add our FinOps lead (Ibrahim Khan, ibrahim@cloudops.co) to the hands-on invite — he needs to validate cost-per-token estimates during the load test.

Preferable kickoff windows for us (ET converted):
- Wed Dec 9, 11:30–12:15 (ET) — corresponds to your Wed 08:30–09:15 PST slot
- Thu Dec 10, 17:00–17:45 (ET) — corresponds to your Thu 14:00–14:45 PST slot

For the hands-on lab we prefer Fri Dec 11 morning (ET) if possible — gives our engineers time to review the prompt bank after kickoff.

On data residency: DataFoundry needs confirmation that logs from the hosted run will be obfuscated and retained for no longer than 90 days; we can cover specifics at kickoff.

Elena
Director, Product — DataFoundry
elena@datafoundry.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@datafoundry.com>, Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.io>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@cloudops.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: stakeholder map, hands-on lab timing, and success criteria

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks — Wed Dec 9 at 08:30 PST (11:30 ET) works for us. I've tentatively held that slot and added Ibrahim to the loop. Proposed final schedule below (I'll convert to calendar invites once everyone confirms):

Confirmed kickoff:
- Wed Dec 9, 08:30–09:15 PST / 11:30–12:15 ET (30–45 min)
Agenda: intros (5), success criteria alignment (10), roles & responsibilities (10), runbook review & blockers (10), next steps (5).

Hands-on lab (preferred):
- Fri Dec 11, 09:00–11:30 PST / 12:00–14:30 ET — focused on prompt review, routing validation, and a scaled 20-min load test (we'll run a short burst at the end).

Success criteria (updated):
- Latency p50 < 120ms on standard prompts (measured on Redwood Dedicated test pool)
- Routing accuracy >= 92% for the provided prompt set (we'll instrument evaluation metrics)
- Load test: stable throughput for target concurrency (we'll define target after you confirm expected QPS)
- Data governance: logs obfuscated; retention policy set to 90 days for the POC run (we'll produce the audit configuration prior to the lab)

Action items for DataFoundry before kickoff:
- Confirm the technical lead for prompt sign-off (name + email)
- Share expected QPS / sample traffic profile for the load test (rough numbers are fine)
- Confirm any additional stakeholders (security, legal) who should be in the kickoff

Links: HubSpot: HUBSPOT-CT-23870; Runbook (preview): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC

If nobody objects I'll send calendar invites (with the runbook attached) by EOD today.

—Aditya
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@datafoundry.com>, Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim@cloudops.co>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: stakeholder map, hands-on lab timing, and success criteria

All — confirmed from our side. Wed Dec 9 at 08:30 PST is good and Vivek will lead the load test on the hands-on lab (Fri Dec 11).

Quick notes for the team:
- Vivek (cc) will prepare a short run-of-show for the load test (target concurrency vs burst profile).
- Aditya, please include the runbook and sample prompts in the calendar invite so DataFoundry has time to review before the kickoff.
- Ibrahim: if you want a short cost model primer before the hands-on, we can slot 15 minutes during the kickoff or send a short note.

See you all Wednesday.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Success — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
